levels.surface: الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمدالبيهقي

notes: The title «الحاكم» is kept as the text writes it; the spacing of «أحمدالبيهقي» is the text's own.
«أن رجلا سأل أبا عبد الله» is a scene: the man who asks is not a link; the Imam named in the words is the last link.
«أبيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link named alone; al-Rida inside the chain stays narrator.
